subject: Urgent: LuminaHealth production latency + 5xx spike — cross-region routing required
messages:
From: Danielle Cortez <danielle.cortez@luminahealth.com>
To: support@redwood.example.com
Date: 2025-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: [P0] Sudden latency and 5xx spike impacting API region us-west-2

Hi Redwood team,

We started seeing a big jump in latency and 5xx errors around 08:50 PT across our production traffic. Error rates on our health-check and inference endpoints jumped from ~0.2% to ~8% and median p95 latency increased from 120ms to 1.2s. This is affecting our customer-facing triage UI and real-time triage pipelines.

Attached are a short log excerpt and a qps heatmap from our side. We’ve already toggled retry/backoff on our SDK and reduced QPS to critical flows, but errors persist. Can you confirm if there are any known AZ issues in us-west-2 or a recent deployment that could correlate? We need a temporary routing/failover plan if this is an AZ degradation.

Please escalate — our SRE is on this thread (ops@luminahealth.com). We’d like an ownership point from Redwood and an ETA for mitigation.

— Danielle
Director of ProdOps
LuminaHealth

Attachment: lumina_5xx_log_excerpt.txt (text/plain)
Attachment: qps_heatmap_20250615.png (image/png)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
To: Danielle Cortez <danielle.cortez@luminahealth.com>, ops@luminahealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Date: 2025-06-15T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [P0] Sudden latency and 5xx spike impacting API region us-west-2

Thanks Danielle — we see the alerts. I'm taking point and looping in Marissa (Escalations) and Sean (Routing).

Quick summary of what we see on our side:
- Backend telemetry shows a concentrated increase in 5xx rate from a handful of hosts in us-west-2a around 08:44 PT.
- KV cache pressure (kvcache miss/eviction rate) spiked concurrently and request queueing increased on that AZ cohort.
- No recent model deployments in the last 24h for your served model; baseline config unchanged.

Immediate actions I’m initiating now:
1) Triggering runbook 'p0-geo-evacuation' to evaluate steering thresholds (link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/p0-geo-steer).
2) Asking Routing to provision a temporary region-level steer to us-west-1 for 20% of your traffic and increase retry budget on compatible model variant.
3) Capturing and attaching our correlation logs (see runbook_p0_steer.md) and opening JIRA INF-9241 for the incident.

Can you confirm SLA sensitivity for the affected endpoints and whether any traffic is pinned to us-west-2 by static DNS? If DNS pinned we may need an app-level change or an IP whitelist update.

We’ll keep you updated every 30 minutes until stable.

— Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: runbook_p0_steer.md

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: 2025-06-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: [P0] Sudden latency and 5xx spike impacting API region us-west-2 — exec ask

Forwarding the thread and proposing an exec-level temporary action. Short summary for leadership channel:

- Impact: LuminaHealth production experiencing ~8% 5xx and p95 latency ~1.2s, started 08:44 PT.
- Root signal: Traffic concentrated on us-west-2a nodes with elevated kvcache evictions and request queueing; likely overloaded host pool causing cascading queue/resets.
- Recommended mitigation (IMMEDIATE): Approve cross-region steer (20–30% to us-west-1) + widen retry window for the next 2 hours. This is non-invasive and reversible; will reduce load on us-west-2a while we do deeper host remediation.
- Customer ask: ownership confirmation + frequent updates; Lumina is sensitive — they have a scheduled marketing push at 11:30 PT that will amplify traffic.

I also recommend we prepare a goodwill credit if this persists >4 hours. Want quick greenlight from Grace (VP Customer Ops) and Sean (Routing lead) to proceed and own the communication.

-- Marissa Cole
Head of Escalations
Redwood Inference

On Jun 15, 2025, at 09:28, aditya_rao@redwood.example.com wrote:
> Thanks Danielle — we see the alerts. I'm taking point and looping in Marissa (Escalations) and Sean (Routing).
> ...

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: 2025-06-15T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: [P0] Sudden latency and 5xx spike impacting API region us-west-2 — exec ask

Confirmed — routing team will enact a staged geo-steer:
- Phase 1 (10m): Divert 15% of LuminaHealth production traffic to us-west-1, monitor error-rate and p95.
- Phase 2 (after 12m stability): Ramp to 30% if error-rate drops <1% and p95 improves.
- Rollback trigger: error-rate in target region >1.5% or increased p99 tail.

I will run the steer and post the control-plane link here (once applied). We'll keep telemetry sliced by AZ so we can identify whether the issue is specific to us-west-2a.

Also capturing an Incident note in INF-9241 and flagging Infra Ops to drain the suspected hosts in us-west-2a.

— Sean Gallagher
Routing Lead, Redwood Inference

On Jun 15, 2025, at 10:05, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com wrote:
> Forwarding the thread and proposing an exec-level temporary action. Short summary for leadership channel:...


Addendum (16:44 PT):
- Steering applied at 10:52 PT (control link: https://console.redwood.example.com/steer/INF-9241). Initial 15% divert immediately cut error-rate from 8% -> 1.1% in ~6 minutes. p95 improved to ~220ms for steered traffic.
- Infra Ops will cordon 4 hosts in us-west-2a for kernel-level investigation; a rolling replacement is scheduled at 11:30 PT.
- Lumina Ops confirmed their scheduled marketing push has been throttled on their side and their SDK retry budget is in place.

Final note: we recommended a 1-off credit conversation if any customer SLA obligations are impacted during the window.
